How it works · Two phones, one story

Three steps – you set it up, they already see it.

No new phone needed, two Android devices are enough. Add a new call button on your own phone and a few seconds later it appears on your parent’s home screen.

Why does Android ask for permissions?

During first setup Android asks for a few one-time permissions: display over other apps, default home app, accessibility service and turning off battery optimization. They keep the home screen locked and let calls start on speaker automatically. The video walks you through each one. In the app, the family member role is called “Caregiver” and the parent’s role “Senior”.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Yes, they do. The two phones only connect if your parent explicitly approves it on their own phone. After that you see the battery level, medication confirmations and (if enabled) location. You never see private messages or hear conversations. All data can be permanently deleted with one tap at any time.

Both phones need Android 8.0 or newer (e.g. Samsung, Xiaomi, Motorola, Honor, Pixel). It doesn’t work on iPhone, because iOS doesn’t allow this kind of home screen lock or automatic speakerphone. A web version for family members with iPhones is currently in development.

Never. Your parent’s phone stays 100% free of ads and payment prompts. After the 14-day free trial, the family member can choose on their own phone via Google Play between the introductory monthly plan (€7.99/mo instead of €9.99) or the discounted annual plan (€59.99/yr instead of €79.99 — just ~€4.99/mo, shown in your local Google Play currency).

Your parent’s phone keeps working for free: locked, simple home screen, call filtering, SOS. Only the remote connection stops.

Not necessarily. On home Wi-Fi, calls between the two phones, reminders and remote settings work without a SIM. Regular phone calls and texts need a SIM card.

Yes, anytime. Tap the clock at the top five times, enter the 4-digit PIN, and you can leave the locked home screen.

No. Any existing Android 8.0+ phone works, no factory reset needed.
